title: QA Lead
description:
Position: QA Lead  
**Budget:** Up to ₹70k – ₹80k  
**Experience:** 6 years

Interested Candidate can share cv on **unnati@addact.net**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor the QA team, assigning tasks and reviewing test deliverables.
* Define and implement QA strategy, test plans, and test cases for web and mobile applications.
* Own the end\-to\-end testing lifecycle including functional, regression, integration, performance, and UAT testing.
* Design and maintain automation testing frameworks and scripts (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, etc.).
* Collaborate with project managers, developers, and business analysts to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Set up and manage test environments and test data.
* Track, log, and manage defects through to resolution using bug\-tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
* Drive process improvements to increase testing efficiency and product quality.
* Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for test case generation, automation scripting, and reporting.
* Prepare and present QA metrics, test reports, and release readiness status to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards and best practices across projects.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 6\+ years of experience in software QA, with at least 1\-2 years in a lead/senior role.
* Strong knowledge of manual and automation testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar).
* Experience with API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured).
* Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with bug\-tracking and test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Azure DevOps).
* Strong knowledge of SQL for backend/database validation.
* Mandatory working knowledge of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for day\-to\-day work.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with strong stakeholder management ability.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner).
* Exposure to CI/CD integration of automated test suites.
* Knowledge of mobile app testing (iOS/Android) and cross\-browser testing.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce/Shopify platform testing.
* Certifications such as ISTQB.

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Java Developer - RESTful API, Spring Boot
description:
Senior Java Developer \- RESTful API, Spring Boot
Gandhinagar, Gujarat
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Senior Developer (Architecture Java/J2EE,rest,Spring Boot) at HCL will play a crucial role in developing, and implementing complex Java/J2EE applications using RESTful services and Spring Boot framework. The primary objective is to contribute to high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Develop, and test java/j2ee applications in adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices.
  

2\. Collaborate within team to analyze requirements, propose technical solutions, and implement features.
  

3\. Build restful apis and integrate with third\-party systems to ensure seamless communication and data exchange.
  

4\. Troubleshoot and debug issues, optimize application performance, and ensure high levels of security.
  

5\. Participate in code reviews, mentor junior developers, and actively participate in agile development processes.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Proficiency in java/j2ee technologies, including java, jsp, servlets, and jpa.
  

2\. Experience in developing and consuming restful web services.
  

3\. Handson experience in spring boot framework for microservices development.
  

4\. Knowledge of database systems like mysql, oracle, or mongodb.
  

5\. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as aws or azure for deployment and scalability.
  

6\. Good problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in a fast paced environment.
